mostWorthwhile.text: The closing image of the folded limbs appearing in the receiving laboratory was the most worthwhile passage; it brings the discovery home without explaining away the mystery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final board felt redundant after the departure and laboratory scenes had already concluded the story.

surprise.text: The ending's silence in the laboratory stood out; it leaves the significance of the specimen unresolved.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter explored what the laboratory learns about the specimen, though this ending also feels complete.
